props.heading:
Five key areas
across three days.

items.label: industry dinner
items.heading: Start the conversation.
items.body: An intimate opening dinner bringing together sponsors, partners, founders, clients and industry leaders. Designed to create meaningful connections, shared perspectives and conversations before the event begins.

items.label: fireside chats & workshops
items.heading: Ideas from the people building them.
items.body: A curated programme of fireside conversations, demonstrations and practical workshops exploring the technologies, workflows and ideas shaping the future of digital experiences.

items.label: installations & experiences
items.heading: Technology you can experience firsthand.
items.body: Interactive installations, demonstrations and showcases exploring how AI, emerging tools and creative technology are changing the way products and experiences are built.

items.label: 24hr builders hackathon
items.heading: Build, test and showcase new ideas.
items.body: Multidisciplinary teams respond to a future facing brief, developing concepts, prototypes and working demonstrations over two days of focused collaboration.

items.label: awards & celebrations
items.heading: Recognise the work worth backing.
items.body: The event concludes with finalist presentations, awards and a closing celebration recognising standout ideas, innovation and the people behind them.
